text:
nina-ops: Heads up — seeing OOB console queue spike in south2. vswitch RX drops + serial buffer backlog. GPU provisioning stuck; ~12 nodes in PENDING. Noticing increased evictions. 😬
stefan: Details? which racks, and any BMC/fw changes rolled recently?
ana-sre: we rolled bmc-fw 1.2.9 to rack-r5 at 03:10 UTC earlier, only partial canary. No bulk yet. Could be the canary misbehaving if it triggers serial retries.
kai-infra: grabbing logs from the provisioner and BMC proxy. quick paste from proxy: ```
Mar 12 03:14:05 bmc-proxy[2478]: bmc_serial: tx_queue_full=1, drops=134
Mar 12 03:14:06 bmc-proxy[2478]: vswitch0: rx_dropped=412, rx_errors=2
Mar 12 03:14:07 provisioner[993]: provisioner: queue_depth=11234, batch_size=12, retry=3
```
nina-ops: gtg. runbook? link? @kai-infra can you try the quick mitigation in runbook?
kai-infra: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oob-console-queue — quick mitigation steps: 1) reduce batch size, 2) temp disable console multiplexing on affected BMCs, 3) add egress QoS on vswitch.
kai-infra: Tried step 1+2 on r5-* and r6-03: `redwood-oobctl set console-mux off --nodes r5-01,r5-02,r6-03` and `provisionerctl set batch_size 4` — queue dropped to ~2k, a few nodes resumed provisioning.
ops-bot: :warning: Alert: provisioning-queue-depth south2 exceeded threshold (11234 -> 2100 after mitigation). Incident created: INC-2026-198.
stefan: good catch. Long term: either rollback 1.2.9 for the canary or patch BMC serial TX handling. @ana-sre any telemetry showing increased serial retries post-1.2.9?
ana-sre: yes, serial retries up ~6x on r5 nodes. Looks like the fw added additional keepalive/heartbeat causing contention on `ttyS0`. Agree we should roll back canary from r5 and hold bulk.
nina-ops: can we shift remaining provisioning traffic to eu1 temporarily to avoid customer impact? how much spare GPU there?
kai-infra: eu1 has ~20% spare across pools; we can route new jobs with policy `route: prefer=eu1 if south2_queue>2000` — pushing a policy change now.
nana-sre: rolled back r5 to 1.2.8 via `bmc-rollback --nodes r5-* --target 1.2.8` for the canary. monitoring shows serial retries falling back after reboot.
stefan: follow-ups: schedule a proper postmortem, add an automated check in deploy pipeline for serial RX/backpressure so canary fails fast.
nina-ops: I'll open a ticket and add notes to the postmortem. Thanks everyone — keeping an eye on the remaining 6 pending nodes. :thumbsup:
